digest.component_or_area: CLI command grammar and argparse factories (src/rebar/_cli/)
propositions: Advanced command grammars across bridge, reconciler, audit, LLM, workflow, identity, and gate families currently mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch and must be extracted into reusable S2a side-effect-free factory contracts
Parser factories must remain lean modules that import no optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing)
Parse-failure handling must be reconciled: migrated handlers currently catching SystemExit must also catch ParseError and emit identical exit code 2 and stderr/usage bytes without tracebacks

Bespoke parser presentation (usage=, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) for verify-opcert, verify-commit, verify-authorship, remote-cert, trusted-env, and nested bridge parsers must be preserved through optional factory keyword passthroughs
Every advanced route must have a valid factory reference and be deterministically generation-ready without executing handlers or importing optional runtimes
Production-path tests must verify no unapproved deltas in nested selection, argv handling, diagnostics, streams, exit codes, and byte-identical help output for commands with custom presentation
